title: Panorra API Go Get Project Report

issues.display_title: Issue #498: Use Authorization Variable in API Collection
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 12/08/26

✅ Implementation: Use Authorization Variable in API Collection

Changes

  • Updated 106 active Authorization request headers to use {{bearerToken}} directly.
  • Removed 131 Authorization entries from saved response examples.
  • Added bearerToken: <YOUR_JWT_TOKEN> to the Dev, Live, and Local - Dev environments.
  • Preserved all non-authorization headers and request settings.
  • Did not use Bruno bearer authentication because it would add the unsupported Bearer prefix.

Usage

  1. Select an API collection environment.
  2. Replace <YOUR_JWT_TOKEN> in bearerToken with a valid Panorra token.
  3. Send a protected request. Its header resolves to:
Authorization: <JWT token>

Verification

rg -n '^\s*value:\s*(Bearer\s+)?eyJ' 'api-collection/Panorra API Feeds'
git diff --check -- api-collection docs/tasks

Verification found zero hardcoded JWT header values. All 106 active authorization headers use {{bearerToken}}; saved response examples contain no authorization headers.

Scope

  • Replace hardcoded JWT values in active Authorization request headers with {{bearerToken}}.
  • Send the token directly without the Bearer prefix.
  • Add bearerToken to the Dev, Live, and Local - Dev environments.
  • Remove hardcoded Authorization headers from saved response examples.
  • Keep all other request headers and endpoint behavior unchanged.

Request Header

Authorization: {{bearerToken}}

Environment Variable

- name: bearerToken
  value: <YOUR_JWT_TOKEN>

Acceptance Criteria

  • Every active Authorization header uses {{bearerToken}}.
  • No active header adds the Bearer prefix.
  • All three environments define bearerToken.
  • Saved response examples contain no Authorization header.
  • No hardcoded JWT remains in the API collection.

RESULT 12/08/26

✅ Implementation: Remove Unused Functions

Changes

  • Removed 33 unreachable functions from nine utility files.
  • Removed helper chains used exclusively by unreachable entry points.
  • Removed imports and the obsolete encryption byte variable left unused by the cleanup.
  • Preserved 34 model TableName() methods because GORM may invoke them through interfaces or reflection.
  • Added no replacement abstractions or dependencies.

Modified Areas

  • Elasticsearch utilities
  • General functions
  • Post functions
  • User functions
  • JWT utilities
  • MinIO utilities
  • RabbitMQ utilities
  • Redis utilities
  • Validation utilities

Verification

go test ./...
go run golang.org/x/tools/cmd/deadcode@latest -test ./...
git diff --check

Results:

  • go test ./... passed.
  • Dead-code analysis reported zero unreachable non-model functions.
  • Its remaining 34 findings are GORM model TableName() hooks and were intentionally retained.
  • git diff --check passed.

Scope

  • Remove production functions with no reachable caller in the application.
  • Remove helper chains used only by another unreachable function.
  • Clean imports and package-level variables made unused by the removals.
  • Preserve GORM TableName() methods because they are framework hooks invoked through interfaces or reflection.
  • Keep application behavior unchanged.
